known_limitations: Data is stored in memory and resets when the process restarts.
The implementation provides a compact core workflow rather than the full breadth of every reviewed requirement.
External integrations such as accounting, email, SMS, calendar, and payment processors are represented only minimally or not implemented.
Concurrency controls, autosave drafts, and advanced audit/history behaviors are simplified.
No persistent database or authentication hardening beyond the sample login flow is included.
